validity.researcher_notes: Capacity 50 bcm a year matches several pages. The sheet length of 2,700 km differs a little from a Nemiga page that says about 2,600 km, and a Kommersant analyst view of more than 2,000 km, so the length is only roughly supported. Diameter 1,420 mm matches the Nemiga page. No wiki citation gives a firm start year. The line is still a plan, with a binding Gazprom agreement signed in September 2025.
